title: Ore Outlines
description: "Makes all ores easier to spot with bright colored outlines. Never miss diamonds in the dark again!"
body:
Are you wandering through dark caves and can't find the ore you need? This mod will help! Ore Outlines makes all ores visible, even in the dark. These ores include: 
Diamonds,
Lapis Lazuli,
Gold,
Iron,
Coal,
Redstone,
Emeralds
and Copper

### BEFORE
